props.name: colors
props.description: Dye colours: up to four CSS colours or tokens, or `'accent'` for a set derived from the theme accent.

props.name: dissipation
props.description: How fast the dye fades, per second. 0 keeps it forever; 3 clears a splat in about a second.

props.name: curl
props.description: Vorticity confinement: how hard small swirls are kept alive. 0 is laminar; 40 is turbulent.

props.name: splatRadius
props.description: Splat size, as a fraction of the shorter side.

props.name: quality
props.description: Simulation and dye resolution. Low for backgrounds on weak devices, high for a showpiece.

props.name: glow
props.description: Bloom strength, 0–1. Brightest in dark mode, a soft halo in light mode. Off at low quality.

props.name: idle
props.description: After a few seconds untouched, keep the fluid moving with gentle random splats.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the simulation on its current frame.

props.name: captureTouch
props.description: Let touch drags stir the fluid instead of scrolling the page. Leave off for a hero the reader scrolls past.

props.name: label
props.description: Describe the image for assistive tech. Without it the canvas is decorative and hidden.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when the simulation starts, or when it falls back.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn on top of the fluid.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a size here.
